title: Some Gameplay Highlights from my current project Battle Wizards
author: Izkimar
selftext:
Here are a few clips from my AI-developed game Battle Wizards, currently playable on spawn.co.

Still chipping away at improvements, mainly focusing on fixing the knockback jitter you can see in the vid and generally polishing the core loop (better UI, easier onboarding for the hop-in style, adding round end UI, etc.)

Let me know what you think if you get a chance to check it out! I always appreciate some feedback.

comments.author: Early-Dentist3782
comments.body: Reminds me of dreams ps4 games.

replies.author: Izkimar
replies.body: Interesting, I never heard of any of those. But I haven't really played any console games since XBOX 360 era lol.

comments.author: Downtown_Lettuce9911
comments.body: Are the attacks always square, or is that part of the VFX update? Aside from [Spawn.co](http://Spawn.co), do you have any other platforms where you publish this game or where users can leave feedback?

replies.author: Izkimar
replies.body:
The magical projectile VFX typically renders square like this on first attempts. But in the past I've gotten it to look more like proper orbs, etc. 

With this game specifically only Spawn.co. They're one of the only ones "at least that I know of" that handle both the development through their own custom engine + AI, and also all the multiplayer/hosting/etc.

replies.author: Downtown_Lettuce9911
replies.body: I noticed your thumbnail is that what the fire orb is going to look like? I’m uncertain if [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com/) can handle it, but I have seen multiplayer games there.

replies.body: Yeah, just ran out of time with it for the contest I was entering. And oh cool I've never heard of that one before.
